_readme: Verse pools for Monday and Wednesday. Persian copied byte-exact from the official Ganjoor data export (github.com/ganjoor/ganjoor-data), the same text ganjoor.net serves. Each verse carries its canonical Ganjoor URL as provenance. Screened clear of wine imagery, seasonal imagery, and anything already published on @hamdam_au.
_weekly_structure: MONDAY hopeful and encouraging, CTA invites the viewer to send it to someone they love. WEDNESDAY philosophical, same kind of CTA. FRIDAY always a fal, always Hafez - see fal-pool.json. Hafez is reserved for Friday; Monday and Wednesday draw on Parvin, Rumi, Saadi and Khayyam.
_wednesday_filter: Philosophical, but a claim TWO PEOPLE CAN STAND INSIDE. The theme is not the test - 'two days cannot be lived' is philosophy and sendable; 'I am still no master' is philosophy and unsendable, because it is a confession. Prefer verses already in first person plural or already addressed to a friend: khayyam sh121 opens 'ey dust biya' and needs no CTA invented, the poem IS the invitation.
_still_needed: Each verse needs a headline, lessonFa/En, sendFa/En, an insight and englishSaid before it can ship - Ganjoor is Persian only. Ealia reviews every Persian and English line. That is the real constraint; supply is not.

monday.poetLineFa: پروین اعتصامی — تبریز و تهران، قرن بیستم
monday.poetLineEn: Parvin Etesami — Tabriz and Tehran, 20th century
monday.persian:
روز بگذشت، ز خواب سحری بگذر
کاروان رفت، رهی گیر و برو، منشین
monday.gloss: The day has gone - leave the dawn sleep behind. The caravan has moved on; take a road, and go. Do not sit.

monday.poetLineFa: پروین اعتصامی — تبریز و تهران، قرن بیستم
monday.poetLineEn: Parvin Etesami — Tabriz and Tehran, 20th century
monday.persian:
چو نیروی بازوت هست، ای توانا
بدرماندگان رحم کن تا توانی
monday.gloss: While there is strength in your arm, you who are able - be merciful to those who are stuck, for as long as you can.

monday.persian:
به جان مضایقه با دوستان مکن سعدی
که دوستی نبوَد هر چه ناتمام کنند
monday.gloss: Saadi, do not hold back from your friends. Whatever is done half-way was never friendship.

monday.poetLineFa: پروین اعتصامی — تبریز و تهران، قرن بیستم
monday.poetLineEn: Parvin Etesami — Tabriz and Tehran, 20th century
monday.persian:
ناتوانی را به لطفی خاطر آوردن بدست
یاد عجز روزگار ناتوانی داشتن
monday.gloss: To lift someone weak with a single kindness - is to remember the season when you were weak yourself.

monday.poetLineFa: پروین اعتصامی — تبریز و تهران، قرن بیستم
monday.poetLineEn: Parvin Etesami — Tabriz and Tehran, 20th century
monday.source: Divan of Parvin Etesami, Mathnavis 146 (نا آزموده)
monday.persian:
در رواج کار خود، چون من بکوش
هر که را پر شیرتر بینی، بدوش
monday.gloss: CHECK BEFORE USE - the second line is spoken by a character inside a fable and may not carry the poem's own view. Verify the context before building anything on it.

wednesday.persian:
ای دوست بیا تا غمِ فردا نخوریم
وین یک دمِ عمر را غنیمت شمریم
wednesday.gloss: Friend, come - let us not eat tomorrow's sorrow, and let us count this one breath of a life as a thing gained.
wednesday.note: THE STRONGEST IN THIS POOL. Opens 'ey dust biya' - addressed to a friend, first person plural, already an invitation. No CTA needs inventing; the poem is the message. Use it first.

wednesday.persian:
بر نامده و گذشته بنیاد مکن
حالی خوش باش و عمر بر باد مکن
wednesday.gloss: Do not build on what has not come or what has gone. Be well now, and do not throw a life to the wind.

wednesday.persian:
بر هر دو مکن تکیه که دوران فلک
در پرده هزار گونه بازی دارد
wednesday.gloss: Lean on neither of the two - the turning of the sky has a thousand kinds of game behind the curtain.

wednesday.persian:
باقی همه رایگان نیرزد‌، هُش دار‌!
تا عمر گران‌بها بدان نفروشی
wednesday.gloss: The rest is not worth having for free - be careful, and do not sell a costly life for it.

wednesday.poetLineFa: پروین اعتصامی — تبریز و تهران، قرن بیستم
wednesday.poetLineEn: Parvin Etesami — Tabriz and Tehran, 20th century
wednesday.persian:
ز غم مباش غمین و مشو ز شادی شاد
که شادی و غم گیتی نمیکنند دوام
wednesday.gloss: Do not be made sad by sorrow, nor glad by joy - neither the world's joy nor its sorrow lasts.

wednesday.poetLineFa: مولانا — بلخ و قونیه، قرن سیزدهم
wednesday.persian:
زمانه روشن و تاریک و گرم و سرد شود
مقام جز به سرچشمه زمانه مکن
wednesday.gloss: The times turn bright and dark, warm and cold. Do not take up residence anywhere but at the source.
